return_policy: Returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery on unopened, sealed products in their original packaging. To initiate a return, email support@musclemax.in with your order number and the reason for return. Opened or tampered products are not eligible for return.
refund_policy: Once a returned item is received and inspected, refunds are processed to the original payment method (UPI, card, or bank transfer) within 5–7 business days. Cash-on-delivery orders are refunded via bank transfer — please provide your bank account details when raising a return request.
delivery_policy: Muscle Max ships across India via Blue Dart and DTDC. Standard delivery takes 3–5 business days after order confirmation. Express delivery (1–2 business days) is available for select metro pin codes at an additional ₹99 charge. Shipping is free on all orders above ₹999. Orders below ₹999 attract a flat ₹79 shipping fee. A tracking link is sent via SMS and email once your order is dispatched. We currently do not ship outside India.
